answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 11346 Country: India Title: Assalama-wa-lekum wa rahmatullahe....... Respected sir, Iwant to name my nephew from these names-md.sharib akhtar,suhit,tahaan, aryan & angel.are these names fine according our religeon?pls.suggest me & also tell me its meaning.i will be highly obliged to you. thanyou! sarwar ali Question: Assalama-wa-lekum wa rahmatullahe....... Respected sir, Iwant to name my nephew from these names-md.sharib akhtar,suhit,tahaan, aryan & angel.are these names fine according our religeon?pls.suggest me & also tell me its meaning.i will be highly obliged to you. thanyou! sarwar ali Answer ID: 11346 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 585/408=L/1430) None of the abovementioned names is right. You should keep any name from those mentioned below: Abdullah, Abdur Rahman, Umar, Talha, Zaid, Abdur Rahim, etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
